intended_object: The uniqueness part of the universal property of the free R-linear category on C: an isomorphism F ≅ G between R-linear functors out of Free R C, built from an isomorphism of their restrictions along the embedding C → Free R C. Inferred from the docstring and the name `ext`.
explanation: This is an extensionality lemma that happens to carry data. Given a natural isomorphism α between embedding ⋙ F and embedding ⋙ G, it builds F ≅ G with components α.app X. Naturality is proved by induction on finitely supported linear combinations of morphisms: additivity handles zero and sums, linearity handles scalar multiples, and naturality of α handles generators. In the literature this is the uniqueness half of the universal property of the free linear category, stated as a lemma rather than defined as an object. It is a technical extensionality device with no standalone textbook definition. The construction is correct and matches its docstring, except that the docstring's 'iff' is only proved in the nontrivial direction; the converse is trivial by whiskering.
